development.developer: Lucky Pinnacle Pte Ltd (Far East Organization)
development.orientation_notes: Two linear blocks (41 & 46 storeys) with direct North/South facing; higher floors get CBD skyline and partial sea view (unverified per stack). Facilities on 7th (pool/tennis/BBQ) and 31st (clubhouse/gym/sky terrace).
known_issues: investor-heavy resident mix (~9:1 leases to sales)
loft units carry double-volume void in strata sqft

layouts.notes: most liquid formats; 560-581 sqft dominate prints
